name: io.github.Servosity/betterstack-mcp
title: Better Stack MCP
description: Every Better Stack Uptime feature, plus an offline SQLite mirror and cross-resource fleet analytics

environmentVariables.name: BETTERSTACK_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the BETTERSTACK_API_TOKEN credential for the Better Stack MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: BETTERSTACK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Better Stack API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: BETTERSTACK_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: BETTERSTACK_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API instead of the local store.

environmentVariables.name: BETTERSTACK_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Better Stack requests.

environmentVariables.name: BETTERSTACK_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
